_note: W14-09. Before/after pairs for the slider (S-03), audit section 3.3. AMENDED (W24-05): four projects, eight slots, every one a placeholder. The section renders on the case la cheie service page and nowhere else. While a slot has no file in public/img/ it renders the W24-01 placeholder and the slot's row in docs/PHOTO-SLOTS-W24.json says what the photograph must show; the slot decides for itself, so the first real pair renders photographs while the other three still render boxes. The before slot takes the light placeholder and the after slot the dark one, so the drag is visibly doing something before any photograph exists. Every pair must be a real Rapid Construct job photographed before and after (audit 5.1 classifies these as RC photo only). Shape: projects[] of { id, title: {ro, ru}, before: slot id, after: slot id, alt_before: {ro, ru}, alt_after: {ro, ru} }. Slot ids name files in public/img/ at 1180x664 (plus @2x); scripts/slots.js registers them from this file, and each image needs its R-W provenance row. build.js refuses a missing projects array, a field that is not real in both locales, and a missing image file. The titles and alt texts are the site's own vocabulary for the kinds of work it already names; nothing about a specific job is claimed, and no project is dated, located or attributed.

_amended_w26_08: W26-08, 2026-09-22. The four titles and the eight alt texts were rewritten to describe the photographs the owner supplied. They were written for a photo session that asked for Casa la cheie, Fatada, Acoperis and Renovare interioara; what arrived is three turnkey builds and one exterior renovation, and no interior. W25-18 set the precedent: where the picture that lands is not the picture the line asked for, the line is corrected to the picture and the change is recorded. The owner knows the real projects and may rename them.
